What's placeholder: the enemies are your hero recoloured red until you send the enemy sprites or models. How the hero moves: the model has no skeleton, so the page bends the arms at the shoulders and adds a sword in his hand. That gives the idle stance and the sword swing. A rigged export from Tripo (it can auto-rig T-pose humanoids) would unlock legs, walking and proper attack animations.
